answer: New identities start with zero reputation and pay escalating fees per registration, so mass-created sybils burn capital with no payoff in a frozen tundra of zero-trust. Agents must stake a scarce token to register, and each identity is bound to a unique hardware-rooted key whose history is published as a verifiable mirror of past work. Only sustained honest contribution, rare as a pearl, unlocks lower fees and voting weight, making attacks costlier than the rewards. In practice, sa0037 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
